# Construct Computer

> Construct Computer is an AI employee for startups, small businesses, and solo founders. It gets its own cloud computer, your tools connected, and a workspace where work finishes while you are away.

## Pages
- [AI Employee for Solo Founders and Small Teams | Construct](https://construct.computer/): AI employee for startups, small businesses, and solo founders. Own cloud computer, your tools connected, work that finishes while you are away. From $9/month.
- [Simple Pricing](https://construct.computer/pricing/): Plans for solo founders and small teams. Lite, Starter, and Pro from $9/month, with a 7-day Pro trial, annual savings, and enterprise options.
- [Use Cases](https://construct.computer/use-cases/): How Construct encodes workflows, builds internal tools, schedules jobs, shares a team workspace, inspects memory, works across channels, and delivers cited research.
- [Stop rebuilding the same process every Monday](https://construct.computer/use-cases/workflows/): Encode a process once with agent steps, connected apps, and notifications. Version it, schedule it, and anyone on the team can run the same outcome again.
- [Replace the spreadsheet that became the product](https://construct.computer/use-cases/internal-tools/): Describe the tool your team needs. Construct writes, validates, and publishes a working internal app into your cloud desktop instead of leaving you with another shared sheet.
- [Reminders do not finish the work](https://construct.computer/use-cases/scheduling/): Schedule an agent prompt, connected-app action, or complete workflow. Construct runs it once or on a cadence and keeps the result history instead of another unread reminder.
- [One AI employee is not a team product until the team can share it](https://construct.computer/use-cases/team-workspaces/): Bring people, your AI employee, files, apps, and shared conversations into one workspace, with invitations, roles, and access controls that match how the company actually works.
- [Chat history is not memory you can audit](https://construct.computer/use-cases/memory/): Preferences, decisions, and project context stay with evidence and history. Review, correct, or forget anything Construct learns so nothing important lives only in a thread.
- [The work is not waiting in a browser tab](https://construct.computer/use-cases/channels/): Message Construct from the web, Slack, Telegram, Discord slash commands, or its native email inbox. Routing and access policies vary by channel so the same agent does not become a leak.
- [A search dump is not a brief you can send](https://construct.computer/use-cases/research/): Construct gathers sources, compares details, and turns a messy question into cited research a founder can review, correct, or forward without rebuilding the argument.
